# OPEN-SMART HX8352B + Arduino Mega 2560

> Hardware-tested solution for a white-screen OPEN-SMART HX8352B 240x400 parallel TFT shield on Arduino Mega 2560. MCUFRIEND_kbv 3.0.0 requires USE_SPECIAL, USE_OPENSMART_SHIELD_PINOUT_MEGA, SUPPORT_8352B and tft.begin(0x0065), not 0x8352.
